title: Group Fitness Class Passes: how a pack is priced, credited and dated at purchase
content:
## Scope
This document states the Group Fitness Class Passes basis for what happens at the moment a class-credit pack is purchased, across every tier of the product.

## Basis
At purchase, the pack is priced at the tier's purchase price, reduced by the tier's multi-pack discount rate if the member already holds another open pack, and reduced by the tier's corporate wellness discount rate if the member holds an active corporate wellness enrollment. Where both conditions hold at once, only the single higher of the two discount rates is applied to the tier's price; the two rates are never applied successively, one on top of the other's already-discounted result. The pack then grants the tier's stated number of class credits (or unlimited use, for the tier whose credit count is represented as unlimited), and its expiration date is set to the purchase date plus the tier's expiration window, counted in calendar days.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical illustration only)
Suppose, purely for illustration, a tier's multi-pack discount rate were 20 percent and its corporate wellness discount rate were 15 percent, and a purchasing member met both conditions at once. The price reduction applied is 20 percent — the higher of the two — not the two rates combined into a 35 percent reduction, and not 15 percent applied first followed by a further 20 percent off the already-reduced amount. A member meeting neither condition pays the tier's full purchase price with no reduction at all.

## Condition-outcome table
| Holds another open pack? | Holds active corporate wellness enrollment? | Discount applied |
|---|---|---|
| No | No | None — full price |
| Yes | No | The tier's multi-pack discount rate |
| No | Yes | The tier's corporate wellness discount rate |
| Yes | Yes | Whichever of the two rates is higher, applied once |
